# By Group, Quantile, and FD {#sec-bygroup}

## III.01 — By First Difference `by_fd(2)` {#sec-iii01}

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat

gazoline = pd.read_stata(
    "https://github.com/chaisemartinPackages/ApplicationData/raw/main/data_gazoline.dta"
)

m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["aoss","waoss"], order=1, placebo=1,
                       aoss_vs_waoss=True, by_fd=2, asinstata=True)
m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngca", ID="id", Time="year", D="tau")
m.summary()
```

## III.02 — IV-WAS by First Difference {#sec-iii02}

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat

gazoline = pd.read_stata(
    "https://github.com/chaisemartinPackages/ApplicationData/raw/main/data_gazoline.dta"
)

m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["ivwaoss"], order=1, controls=["lngpinc"],
                       placebo=1, by_fd=2, asinstata=True)
m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngca", ID="id", Time="year", D="lngpinc", Z="tau")
m.summary()
```
